Good, that's just the tracking file. The task is complete. Here's the final report:

## Summary

**PR:** [FChecklist/projexa#42](https://github.com/FChecklist/projexa/pull/42) — merged (squash), branch deleted. CI (Lint, Type Check, Build) and Vercel preview all green. `bunx tsc --noEmit` / `bun run lint` / `bun run build` all clean; `bun test` has nothing to run (this repo has zero test files/no test script — pre-existing, not introduced by this change). Claim registered and closed via compliance-tracker PR #473 and #474 (both merged).

**What changed:** Bumped `@fchecklist/veridian-ui-kit` to v0.2.2 and swapped PROJEXA's hand-rolled `layout.tsx`/`AppSidebar.tsx`/`AppTopbar.tsx`/`VeriChatPanel.tsx` for the shared package's real `AppShellFrame`/`AppSidebar`/`AppHeader`/`PanelShell`, following compliance-tracker's proven PR #471 pattern, unconditionally.

**Honest AppHeader slot-by-slot status:**
- **User-menu**: Real — Supabase Auth sign-out (matching `SettingsClient.tsx`'s pattern), real email/org name from `/api/organization`.
- **Panel-toggle**: Real — new `panelCollapsed` state actually shows/hides `VeriChatPanel`.
- **Search**: Honestly omitted (`searchSlot={false}`). Grepped first — PROJEXA has no search mechanism anywhere in the codebase. Not built, not faked.
- **Notifications**: Honestly omitted (`notificationSlot={false}`). No `/api/notifications` route or notification concept exists anywhere. Not built, not faked.

(`false` rather than leaving the props unset was required — `AppHeader`'s own fallback only treats `null`/`undefined` as empty and otherwise renders a decorative dead button.)

**Also disclosed:** `VeriComposer.tsx` stays local — the shared composer requires non-empty free text before dispatch, but PROJEXA's real dispatch is deterministic (codeReference+fixedInputs, no text needed), same class of conflict compliance-tracker found for its VCEL calculator. Nav active-highlighting loses query-string awareness once a project is selected (links still work). `ProjectSwitcher` moved above the sidebar's logo block (no slot for its old position). Per-page sticky header titles are gone, replaced by in-content headings.
